policy: Every requirement is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the page named in source_roles. Nothing is inferred.
structure_note: Three alternative routes in, not three conditions. The page numbers them, and the third depends on the first two — a family member qualifies only if their relative falls within item 1 or 2, and only after twelve months' lawful settlement of their own.
freshness_note: No dateline is published and the body mentions no year. Tracked by check-source-freshness as '[none published]', the same condition as Singapore's MOM and the US ESTA pages already live.
not_extracted: The family-status documents the page lists as 'as applicable' rather than required.

requirements.label: Two years lawfully settled with progressive integration
requirements.description: The first of three alternatives. The page qualifies it with prior lawful employment or particularly close social and family ties.
requirements.source_excerpt: you have been lawfully settled in austria for two years and are progressively integrated (if you have previously been lawfully employed or when – under certain circumstances – admission to employment is necessary due to your particularly close social and family ties to austria), or
requirements.source_excerpt_display: you have been lawfully settled in Austria for two years and are progressively integrated (if you have previously been lawfully employed or when – under certain circumstances – admission to employment is necessary due to your particularly close social and family ties to Austria), or

requirements.label: Or hold a valid work permit or exemption certificate
requirements.description: The second alternative, and the shortest path for someone already working lawfully.
requirements.source_excerpt: you hold a valid work permit or a valid exemption certificate, or
requirements.source_excerpt_display: you hold a valid work permit or a valid exemption certificate, or

requirements.label: Or be a family member of someone in the first two groups, after twelve months settled
requirements.description: Derivative and conditional: it depends on the relative qualifying, and adds a twelve-month settlement requirement of its own.
requirements.source_excerpt: you are a family member of a third-country national who falls within the scope of item 1. or 2., provided you have been lawfully settled in austria for twelve months.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: you are a family member of a third-country national who falls within the scope of item 1. or 2., provided you have been lawfully settled in Austria for twelve months.

requirements.label: Photo, 45x35mm, taken within six months
requirements.source_excerpt: a photo (dimensions: 45x35mm) of the applicant, taken recently (six months ago or less)
